steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's credential requirements to verify you meet the hours needed. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can answer eligibility questions and help you assess your background against PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend interactive sessions from anywhere, on a schedule that fits your work in Oil & Gas, Port & Maritime, Healthcare, Defense, Construction, or Education. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world context and exam-focused content across all five process groups.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay the PMI exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure your submission is complete and accurate.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers targeted exam-preparation support to reinforce bootcamp content and build confidence. Schedule your exam with Prometric at a test center convenient to you. Our instructors equip you with strategies and practice to perform your best on exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to keep your credential active. PMI accepts PDUs from training, volunteer work, and professional activities. Plan your renewal early and track your progress throughout the cycle to stay current and competitive in your field.
